name: Why is my outdoor faucet leaking?

mainEntity.name: Why is my outdoor faucet leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outdoor faucets typically leak due to worn-out washers, seals, or packing within the faucet assembly. Freezing temperatures can also cause internal damage, leading to cracks in the valve body or pipes. A persistent drip can waste significant water and indicate a larger issue that could worsen over time, especially if not addressed before colder weather. CG Plumbing Solutions regularly inspects these components as part of our repair process to ensure a lasting fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes of outdoor faucet leaks include worn washers, seals, or freezing damage to the internal components. Timely repair prevents water waste and further damage.
